expect.setup:
sh << TCSETUP
umask 077
D=\$HOME/.tcgen; mkdir -p \$D
printf '%s\\n' 'cat "\$HOME/.tcgen/vmpw"' > \$D/askpass
: > \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'SSH_ASKPASS="\$HOME/.tcgen/askpass"; DISPLAY="\${DISPLAY:-tcgen:0}"; SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE=force' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'export SSH_ASKPASS DISPLAY SSH_ASKPASS_REQUIRE' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'O="-x -o ConnectTimeout=10 -o NumberOfPasswordPrompts=1"' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'if ssh -G -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new localhost >/dev/null 2>&1; then' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' '  O="\$O -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new"' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'else' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' '  O="\$O -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no"' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'fi' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'echo "---- \$1"' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'setsid ssh \$O "\$1" sh -s' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'R=\$?' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' '[ \$R -eq 0 ] || echo "==== \$1 FAILED (ssh exit \$R)"' >> \$D/vmssh
printf '%s\\n' 'exit \$R' >> \$D/vmssh
: > \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'D=\$HOME/.tcgen' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'umask 077' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'while read -r -t 1 X 2>/dev/null; do :; done' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'trap '\\''stty echo 2>/dev/null'\\'' 0 2 15' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'stty -echo 2>/dev/null' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'PW=' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'while [ -z "\$PW" ]; do' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' '  printf '\\''VM password: '\\''' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' '  IFS= read -r PW || exit 1' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' '  PW=\`printf '\\''%s'\\'' "\$PW" | tr -d '\\''\\r'\\''\`' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' '  echo' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'done' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'stty echo 2>/dev/null' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'printf '\\''%s\\n'\\'' "\$PW" > \$D/vmpw' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'chmod 600 \$D/vmpw' >> \$D/setpw
printf '%s\\n' 'echo "saved: \$D/vmpw"' >> \$D/setpw
chmod 700 \$D/askpass \$D/vmssh \$D/setpw
echo "created: \$D (askpass, vmssh, setpw)"
TCSETUP
sh ~/.tcgen/setpw
